data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ktm', meaning 'to complete' or 'to fulfill'. In the context of female names, Kattamah signifies 'the one who is elevated or exalted'. The name Kattamah carries the meaning “Elevated, Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian.
